description.value:
Autopilots are ubiquitous throughout the Pact Worlds on all manner of vehicles. It takes 10 minutes to install an autopilot into a vehicle, during which time the vehicle can't be occupied as it calibrates itself and runs extensive diagnostics. Once installed, you can control the vehicle remotely using your comm unit with a range of 20 miles. A commercial autopilot has a +4 modifier to Piloting and can forego rolling a skill check for Piloting to instead receive a result of 10 + its modifier.

Activate—Autopilot 1

Requirements The autopilot is attached to a vehicle

Effect The autopilot Drives, Speeds Up, or Stops its attached vehicle.
